entries.verified: CTO-16 Copilot §4, read 2026-11-06: "Built-in agent tools can only read and write files within the current workspace folder" (Scope and isolation). Read-only access to more folders only via chat.additionalReadAccessFolders.

CTO-16 Copilot §4, read 2026-11-06: chat.tools.edits.autoApprove default {} = no file requires approval, so workspace edits apply without asking (the map lists files that REQUIRE approval; security baseline adds globs like "**/.env": false to protect files). Edits are written to disk and reviewed after with Keep/Undo, not approved before.
CTO-16 Copilot §4, read 2026-11-06: built-in agent tools cannot write outside the current workspace folder (Workspace-limited file access).

CTO-16 Copilot §4, read 2026-11-06: chat.tools.terminal.enableAutoApprove default true; chat.tools.terminal.autoApprove defaults deny rm/rmdir/del/kill/curl/wget/eval/chmod/chown and /^Remove-Item\b/i, and common read-only commands run automatically — the product's rule list decides.
CTO-16 Copilot §4, read 2026-11-06: chat.tools.urls.autoApprove default []; URL fetches use a two-step approval (trust the domain, then review the fetched content).
CTO-16 Copilot §4, read 2026-11-06: "MCP tool invocations require explicit user approval" by default (Tool approval).
CTO-16 Copilot §4, read 2026-11-06: chat.permissions.default default "default" = Manual permissions; chat.agent.enabled default true; what is not auto-approved asks the user.
